items.text: Early-week (Tue) note; first official practice reports come Wednesday. Minnesota: WR Jordan Addison needs thumb surgery, could go to IR. OUT - TE T.J. Hockenson (wrist/chest), LB Blake Cashman, QB Kyler Murray (hamstring). QUESTIONABLE - LB Andrew Van Ginkel (quad, expected to practice). IR - G Donovan Jackson. Kirk Cousins starts.

Early-week (Tue) note; first official practice reports come Wednesday. San Francisco: WR Mike Evans (Achilles) may return to practice this week. WR Brandon Aiyuk on roster exemption. IR - CB Nate Hobbs, WR Christian Kirk, WR Ricky Pearsall (season). Brock Purdy starts.
